description: What the suite of git_push on real repositories must notice: the checks that run before the owner is asked (trust, remote, address, branch, protected branches, fast-forward, the range, the scan), what the push command looks like, what is held to what was shown, what the tool and the gate say. One exact replacement per mutation, each pattern occurring once.

mutations.name: plan-trust-skipped
mutations.what: a repository whose configuration names a program for the network is pushed from

mutations.name: plan-trust-credential-only
mutations.what: only credential.helper is looked for in the configuration

mutations.name: plan-trust-transport
mutations.what: a proxy or a switched-off certificate check in the repository's configuration is pushed through

mutations.name: transport-subsection
mutations.what: http.<url>.proxy (a setting for one address) is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-https-section
mutations.what: the https. section is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-proxy-auth
mutations.what: http.proxyAuthMethod is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-sslverify
mutations.what: http.sslVerify is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-sslcainfo
mutations.what: http.sslCAInfo is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-sslcapath
mutations.what: http.sslCAPath is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-sslcert
mutations.what: http.sslCert is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-sslkey
mutations.what: http.sslKey is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-pinned
mutations.what: http.pinnedPubKey is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-header
mutations.what: http.extraHeader is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-cookies
mutations.what: http.cookieFile is not looked for

mutations.name: transport-curloptresolve
mutations.what: http.curloptResolve (an override of the DNS answer for a host) is not looked for

mutations.name: plan-trust-worktree-scope
mutations.what: the per-worktree configuration (.git/config.worktree) is not read for the HTTP transport settings

mutations.name: plan-trust-local-scope
mutations.what: the shared configuration is not read when the worktree file is in use

mutations.name: plan-several-addresses
mutations.what: a remote with several push addresses is pushed to at all of them

mutations.name: plan-address-all-flag
mutations.what: only the first push address of a remote is looked at

mutations.name: plan-remote-skipped
mutations.what: a remote that is not configured is pushed to

mutations.name: plan-address-skipped
mutations.what: an address that names a helper program is accepted

mutations.name: plan-address-helper
mutations.what: ext::... and x::y are not recognised as programs

mutations.name: plan-address-option
mutations.what: an address that starts with - is accepted

mutations.name: plan-detached-head
mutations.what: a detached HEAD is pushed under an empty name

mutations.name: plan-odd-name
mutations.what: the current branch is pushed under a name that cannot be shown honestly

mutations.name: plan-branch-missing
mutations.what: a branch that does not exist goes on to the next check

mutations.name: plan-protected-branch
mutations.what: main, master and the default branch pass the plan

patches.old:
protectedBranchReason(name, defaultBranch);
  if (protectedReason) return fault('push_protected_branch', protectedReason);

mutations.name: plan-default-from-origin-head
mutations.what: origin/HEAD is not read, so the default branch is only known by the remote at push time

mutations.name: plan-fast-forward
mutations.what: a rewritten branch goes on to a push that only a force could do

mutations.name: plan-nothing-to-push
mutations.what: a branch the remote has in full is put to the owner

mutations.name: plan-range-everything
mutations.what: the commits the remote already has are listed and scanned as well

mutations.name: plan-list-uncapped
mutations.what: the list of commits is not limited to fifty

mutations.name: plan-list-order
mutations.what: the newest commit is listed first

mutations.name: plan-scan-cut
mutations.what: an answer of Git that was cut is scanned as it is

mutations.name: plan-scan-limit
mutations.what: a range longer than the limit is pushed unread

mutations.name: plan-secret
mutations.what: a secret in the commits does not stop the push

mutations.name: plan-protected-file
mutations.what: a protected file in the commits does not stop the push

mutations.name: plan-upstream-default
mutations.what: the upstream is never set unless the call says so

mutations.name: exec-stale-plan
mutations.what: a plan whose branch has moved is executed

mutations.name: exec-remote-default
mutations.what: the remote is not asked for its default branch

patches.old:
protectedBranchReason(branch, remoteDefault);
    if (protectedReason) return fault('push_protected_branch', protectedReason);

mutations.name: exec-no-porcelain
mutations.what: the push does not ask for the machine-readable answer

mutations.name: exec-hooks
mutations.what: the push runs the hooks of the repository

mutations.name: exec-tags
mutations.what: the push sends the tags that the branch reaches

mutations.name: exec-submodules
mutations.what: the push pushes the submodules too

mutations.name: exec-force
mutations.what: the push forces

mutations.name: exec-refspec
mutations.what: the branch is given by its short name, not as refs/heads/b:refs/heads/b

mutations.name: exec-upstream
mutations.what: the upstream is never set

mutations.name: exec-timeout
mutations.what: the push has no timeout of its own

patches.old: { signal, writes: true, timeoutMs: left(), maxBytes: 400_000 }

mutations.name: exec-range
mutations.what: the result does not say what the remote had before

patches.old: range: { from: plan.trackingSha ?? null, to: plan.headSha }

mutations.name: exec-upstream-name
mutations.what: the result does not say which upstream was set

mutations.name: exec-words
mutations.what: Git's output is returned as it is, credentials included

mutations.name: exec-rejected
mutations.what: a push that the remote declined is reported as an ordinary failure

mutations.name: tool-blocked
mutations.what: a push that is refused is put to the owner as a question

mutations.name: tool-category
mutations.what: git_push is an ordinary edit, not a dangerous operation

mutations.name: tool-stale-plan
mutations.what: the call is not held to the head that was shown

mutations.name: tool-stale-address
mutations.what: the call is not held to the address that was shown

mutations.name: tool-memo-task-key
mutations.what: what one task was shown is not told apart from what another task was shown about the same branch

mutations.name: tool-plan-task
mutations.what: the question remembers its head under no task

mutations.name: tool-push-task
mutations.what: the call looks for what it was shown under no task

mutations.name: tool-assess-task
mutations.what: the assessment does not know which task asks

mutations.name: tool-assess-context
mutations.what: the assessment of a tool is not told which task it is for

mutations.name: gate-assess-context
mutations.what: the gate does not hand the task to the assessment of a local tool

mutations.name: gate-assess-task
mutations.what: authorize does not say which task asks

mutations.name: tool-memo-address
mutations.what: the address that was shown is not remembered, so every call after a question looks changed

mutations.name: tool-summary
mutations.what: the question does not say which branch goes where

mutations.name: tool-check
mutations.what: the values of the arguments are not checked

mutations.name: tool-annotations
mutations.what: git_push says it only reads

patches.old: annotations: { readOnlyHint: false, destructiveHint: false, openWorldHint: true },

mutations.name: tool-detail
mutations.what: the question carries no commits

mutations.name: assess-detail
mutations.what: the assessment of a tool drops the detail the gate needs

mutations.name: assess-code
mutations.what: the assessment of a tool drops the code of a refusal

mutations.name: assess-summary
mutations.what: the assessment of a tool ignores the summary the tool made from the repository

mutations.name: gate-describe
mutations.what: the request shows the arguments of the model, not the commits

mutations.name: gate-always-ask
mutations.what: git_push is not on the list of names that Full Access never waives

mutations.name: gate-sandbox
mutations.what: sandbox-only lets the push through to the question

mutations.name: gate-assess
mutations.what: the gate drops the detail and the code of the assessment
